scope: Stock Phase A G2/G4 page-bound and count characterization; upstream clients only, NOT SDK or adapter verification
characterized: Malformed NaN bounds and invalid/cap bounds have backend-specific behavior; they remain reject-before-wire adapter inputs.
Reference last-set wire bounds preserve zero-width range errors; ordinary no-count out-of-range pages remain empty.
Out-of-range exact-count behavior differs: native loses total while reference returns a range error.
Both installed clients serialize the unsafe offset 2^53 and return an empty out-of-range page.
explicitNonClaims: No range/query adapter implementation or request-count/error-origin tests.
Malformed inputs observed in the stock clients are not accepted by the approved portable input domain.
